full_judgment: 5. Mr. Md. Ahsanul Kabir, the learned Advocate for the petitioners submits that it was beyond the jurisdiction of the learned District Judge to revise the order dated 10.11.91 by the impugned order without giving an opportunity to the defendants petitioners. In this connection the learned Advocate for the defendants petitioners referred to the cases reported in 22 D.L.R. (SC) 41; AIR 1978 (Nag) 144; 22 D.LR. (SC) 694.
